# Contributing

This is a snapshot of my own Obsidian vault's workflow layer, shared so you can take what's useful. It isn't a project with a roadmap.

**Issues are the channel.** Bugs, contradictions between docs, a workflow you think is missing, or just telling me a part of it didn't make sense — all of it goes in an issue. The most useful ones name a file and say what you expected to happen.

**Pull requests aren't watched.** I don't read them as a suggestion queue, so anything sent that way is likely to sit. If you've already made the fix, open an issue and paste the diff in it — that I'll see.
